item.title: Leave a Key Return Note
item.prompt_text: You borrowed a yellow key for Room 2. You will return it at 5 p.m. The desk closes at 4. Put the key in the small box by the door. Leave a note that explains which key it is, when you returned it, and where it is.
item.audience: the person at the studio desk
item.target_grammar: Simple present for location and past simple for the return.
item.target_structure: Write the room number, then give the time and the location.
